description: This is a C source file implementing a Bluetooth LE scanner using Zephyr RTOS, handling extended advertisements, connection management, and event-driven scanning logic.

methods.name: raise_evt
methods.description: Sets an event bit and signals the poll event to notify the main loop.

methods.name: connected_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon Bluetooth connection establishment.

methods.name: recycled_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a connection object is recycled.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a Bluetooth advertisement packet.

methods.name: attempt_connection
methods.description: Attempts to stop scanning and initiate a connection to the device with the extended advertisement.
